# traces stats

Show where time goes: duration stats per span name over many traces.

Groups every span in the time range by SpanName and ServiceName and
prints count, p50, p95, max, and total duration, sorted by total time.
Pass `--root` to only count spans inside traces of one operation, e.g.
the steps of every `POST /checkout` request. Use this instead of
running `strada traces view` on many traces to compute medians.

## Usage

```sh
strada traces stats
```

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `-p, --project [slug]` | - | Project slug override (repeatable, defaults to folder setup) |
| `--org [name-or-id]` | - | Organization override (defaults to folder setup) |
| `-s, --service [name]` | - | Filter by ServiceName |
| `--root [name]` | - | Only spans in traces whose root span has this SpanName |
| `--since [time]` | - | Start time: duration (1h, 7d) or ISO date (default: 1h) |
| `--until [time]` | - | End time: duration (1h) or ISO date |
| `-n, --limit [count]` | - | Max span names (default: 50) |
| `--json` | - | Print raw JSON response |

## Global Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `-h, --help` | - | Display this message |
| `-v, --version` | - | Display version number |

## Examples

```sh
strada traces stats -s api --root 'POST /checkout' --since 3h
```
